key_insight: DiaCap learns what was said, when it was said, and who said it in one audiovisual model. It connects utterance timing with speaker identification to generate richer dialogue captions.
problem_solved: Video dialogue captioning must align speech transcripts with precise timing and visually identify speakers—closely related tasks that benefit from being handled together.
method: Use a single audiovisual large language model to generate each utterance’s transcript, timestamps, and visual speaker description.
Jointly learn utterance timing and audiovisual speaker diarization rather than treating them as separate tasks.
Train in two complementary stages, beginning with 225K curated clips containing detailed synthetic utterance captions; the provided abstract is truncated before describing the refinement stage.
impact: DiaCap offers a unified approach to speaker-aware, time-aligned video captions, potentially simplifying video understanding and accessibility workflows. The provided excerpt does not report performance results.

paper_authors: Binfei Ji, Zhiwen Cao, Anqi Yang, Prem Seetharaman, Shuo Yang
